About the call

Our founder, who has 20+ years in design. You talk to the person who shapes the recommendation, not a sales team.

About [confirm call length with Chintan], at a time you pick in our calendar.

Nothing formal. It helps to know the metric you want to move and where you think it's stuck. Bring analytics or past test results if you have them.

Yes. Every engagement runs under a mutual NDA, you keep full IP ownership, and we use your data only for your project. If you need the NDA before the call, tell us when you book.

Working together

We recommend where to start: a UX audit, a project, or a partnership. An audit is a fixed fee, quoted after this one call, with the report in about 3 days once we have analytics access.

Usually with a UX Audit or a strategy workshop. Both scope the work and surface the priorities before you commit to a larger project.

Yes, often. We can lead a project end to end or work alongside your team to add capacity and an outside perspective.

Yes. Alongside our direct clients, we partner with agencies and work under their brand when needed.
